title: The GPU: from silicon to scale

A full visual handbook covering prerequisites, parallel execution, memory, tensor arithmetic, profiling, programming, and model capacity.

Begin with the hardware question

A GPU trades substantial chip resources for parallel throughput. Performance depends on whether independent work exists and whether data can arrive fast enough. Arithmetic units, on-chip storage, device memory, and links form a system whose bottleneck changes with the workload.

Follow the complete handbook

The dedicated GPU reference contains 24 classified sections, interactive roofline and occupancy models, memory-access visualizations, a capacity planner, programming examples, and diagnostic workflows. Start with the foundations or jump directly to a practical lab.
